title: Resource Contention in Production
headline: The recommendation row that slowed checkout
baodium_adds: A personalized 'Recommended for you' row on every product page
store_state_after: Recommendations are optional content: 16 permits per Product Page instance, a 150 ms budget, a fallback; Recommendation Service sized within the PostgreSQL session budget with its own admission limit.

acts.title: The pool
acts.note: Keep your current implementation. Start it from the recommendation-call act's state (100% rollout, pool full).

acts.title: Live lab
acts.teardown: Killercoda ends the session when the learner closes the tab or time runs out. Locally: `baodium teardown`.

takeaways: Acquisition is not execution: requests waited for a connection while the SQL stayed fast.
Exposure is not traffic: '1% of customers' said nothing about lookups reaching one pool of 40.
Optional work must stay optional: bounded permits, a time budget derived from the deadline, and a fallback.

next_teaser.text: Baodium plans capacity for its biggest sale, and you do the arithmetic before the rollout, not after.
